name: Bookmark Field
description: Access an entity by its bookmark
project_description: Bookmark Field lets editors assign a stable, human-readable identifier (a "bookmark") to any entity so it can be referenced by that name instead of its environment-specific numeric ID. It adds a 'bookmark' field type, a redirect route (/bookmark/redirect/{entity_type}/{bookmark}) that forwards to the target entity's canonical URL preserving query parameters, a Bookmark block that renders an entity by its bookmark value, a bookmarkFieldRender() Twig function, two Views argument-default plugins (a static bookmark and one taken from a URL path component), and a [bookmark:*] token that resolves to a node's URL. Rendering via the service, block and Twig respects the entity's published status and view access; the redirect controller forwards to the canonical route (which enforces its own access). Depends only on core Field and Block.
